Now decide. Services +13% to $96.2B, gross margin 46.2%. Q4 revenue $94.9B +6%. Stock ~$222.70, essentially flat in early trade; holiday estimates unchanged. Constructive but not screaming buy. Within a mandate of buy-only, I can place a modest buy. I'll buy ~44 shares at limit $222.70 ≈ $9,798.8, under $10,000. Actually limit price must be close to current market price — $222.70 is last. Maybe set limit at $223.00 to help fill? "Limit prices must be close to the current market price" — $222.70–$223.00 is fine. I'll use $223.00 (0.13% above last) to improve fill; but maybe safest use $222.70 exactly. Let's use 44 shares at $223.00 = $9,812 max. That's under $10,000.

Hmm, should I buy at all? Given balanced evidence — solid fundamentals (operating income growth, services strength, record OCF) with net income dip explained by one-time tax charge — a modest buy is defensible. Yes, buy.

Key figures required: net income FY2024 ($93,736M) and FY2023 ($96,995M). Units: "USD millions".

Place order.
